scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c "#f6c915,#073590" "npm run dev --workspace backend" "npm run dev --workspace frontend"
scripts.build: npm install --no-save @rollup/rollup-linux-x64-gnu@4.64.0 && npm run build --workspace frontend
scripts.preview: concurrently -n backend,preview -c "#073590,#f6c915" "PORT=9797 CORS_ORIGIN=http://localhost:4273 npm run start --workspace backend" "VITE_API_BASE_URL=http://localhost:9797 npm run preview --workspace frontend -- --port 4273"
